title: Okwemulugunya Okuwuliddwa Waggulu w'Oluyoogaano
intro: Owulira eddoboozi nga lisituka okuva mu bantu ng’okunyigirizibwa kufuuse kwa bulijjo. Tewali kwolesebwa kwa buyinza kuddamu kwemulugunya; mu kifo ky’ekyo, okujulira obutereevu kutuuka eri Allah, era okuddamu ne kukuba ku mutima gw’okusinza kwennyini. Ani yakola okwemulugunya okwo, kibuuzo ki ekyaddirira, era mazima ki agaakakasibwa?
clues: Natandika okunyigirizibwa olw’okunyigirizibwa kw’abantu abaali banneetoolodde.
Okwemulugunya okwo nakutegeeza Allah butereevu mu kwemulugunya okw’obuntu.
Allah yawulira okwemulugunya n’addamu n’okusoomoozebwa ku nzikiriza yange.
Eky’okuddamu kyabuuza engeri gye nnali nsobola okulemererwa okukkiriza Allah, ali Omu era ow’oku ntikko.
Olwo ne mbuuza lwaki Allah yandibadde asiima abantu abaali batakkiriza.
Nze Uzair, erinnya mu Surah Az-Zukhruf nga oyo Allah gwe yawulira okwemulugunya kwe.

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
